mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_posting ( user_idx, region_idx, title, employer, category, description, pay_type, pay, work_period, work_days, start_time, end_time, time_negotiable, start_date, end_date, location, location_detail, location_lat, location_lng, deadline, contact, benefits, created_date, recruit_status ) VALUES ( #{userIdx}, #{regionIdx}, #{title}, #{employer}, #{category}, #{description}, #{payType}, #{pay}, #{workPeriod}, #{workDays}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{timeNegotiable, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{endDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{location}, #{locationDetail, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{locationLat, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{locationLng, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deadline, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{contact}, #{benefits, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, 'RECRUITING' )
mapper.select: SELECT posting_idx AS postingIdx, user_idx AS userIdx, title, employer, pay_type AS payType, pay, work_days AS workDays, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, created_date AS createdDate, recruit_status AS recruitStatus FROM job_posting ORDER BY posting_idx DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT posting_idx AS postingIdx, user_idx AS userIdx, region_idx AS regionIdx, title, employer, category, description, pay_type AS payType, pay, work_period AS workPeriod, work_days AS workDays, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, time_negotiable AS timeNegotiable, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate, location, location_detail AS locationDetail, deadline, contact, benefits, hit_count AS hitCount, created_date AS createdDate, recruit_status AS recruitStatus FROM job_posting WHERE posting_idx = #{postingIdx}
